faq: Do you charge for roof inspections?
No. Inspections are free and there's no obligation to hire us.
Can you fix a leak without replacing the roof?
Often, yes. Many leaks come from flashing, vents or a few damaged shingles. We'll recommend a repair when a repair is the right call.
How fast can you come out?
Call (832) 555-0100 and we'll get you on the schedule as soon as possible. Active leaks get priority.

faq: What should I do right after a storm damages my roof?
Stay safe and off the roof. Take photos from the ground if you can, then call us. We can tarp the damage to stop leaks and document everything for your insurance company.
Do you offer emergency tarping?
Yes. Temporary protection keeps water out until permanent repairs are made.
Will my insurance pay for a new roof?
It depends on your policy and the cause of the damage. We document the damage and help you understand the process, but the decision belongs to your insurance company.

Most financing partners pre-qualify you with a soft credit check, which doesn't affect your score. Ask us about the partner we work with.

Do you help with insurance claims?
